name: Setting out
text: Once upon a time, three little pigs set off to build homes of their own.

name: Meet Pip
text: Pip liked to do things quickly.

name: Meet Poppy
text: Poppy liked to make things beautiful.

name: Meet Bruno
text: And Bruno liked to think things through.

name: Three sunny spots
text: They found three sunny spots beside a winding woodland path. Neighbors! said Poppy. Perfect, said Bruno.

name: A race to finish
text: Whoever finishes first gets a nap! said Pip. And off they went.

name: Armfuls of straw
text: Pip gathered great armfuls of straw. He stacked it here. He tucked it there.

name: A door in the front
text: He pushed a door into the front. By lunchtime, he had a house. Finished!

name: Mostly finished
text: A little piece of the roof drifted down onto his nose. Pip blew it away. Mostly finished.

name: Time for a nap
text: He went inside, put his feet up, and fell asleep.

name: Interesting sticks
text: Poppy gathered sticks. Long sticks. Short sticks. Sticks with interesting little bends.

name: A pretty house
text: She tied them together, added a roof, and hung a flower beside the door.

name: Lovely
text: Then she stepped back to admire her work. Lovely!

name: A little lean
text: The house leaned a little to the left. Poppy straightened the flower. There. Much better.

name: Brick by brick
text: Bruno built with bricks. He measured. He spread mortar. He laid each brick carefully.

name: Another row
text: One row. Then another. Then another.

name: Still building
text: Pip wandered over. Are you still building? Yes, said Bruno.

name: An offer of a flower
text: Poppy peeked around the wall. Would you like a flower? When I have somewhere to hang it.

name: A sturdy little house
text: By sunset, Bruno had finished a sturdy little house with a strong door, a snug roof, and a tall brick chimney.

name: Ready for a nap
text: He hung Poppy's flower beside the door. Then he sat down. Now, he said, I'm ready for that nap.

name: Someone wakes
text: But someone else had just woken up. Someone with sharp ears. A long nose. And a very empty stomach.

name: Following his nose
text: The wolf came padding along the woodland path. He sniffed. He stopped. He smiled. Pig.

name: The first knock
text: He followed his nose to Pip's straw house and knocked three times.

name: Let me come in
text: Little pig, little pig, let me come in!

name: Rather a lot of teeth
text: Pip peered through a gap in the wall. He saw a nose. Then teeth. Rather a lot of teeth.

name: Chinny chin chin
text: Not by the hair on my chinny chin chin!

name: The first warning
text: The wolf straightened his shoulders. Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in!

name: Huff and puff
text: He took a deep breath. He huffed. He puffed. And...

name: Straw everywhere
text: Straw flew everywhere!

name: Run to Poppy
text: Pip shot out the back and raced down the path. Poppy! Open the door!

name: Safe for a moment
text: Poppy pulled him inside. What happened?

name: A field
text: My house, panted Pip, has become a field.

name: Another knock
text: Soon, three knocks rattled Poppy's door.

name: Two little pigs
text: Little pigs, little pigs, let me come in!

name: Together behind the door
text: The pigs squeezed together behind the door. Not by the hairs on our chinny chin chins!

name: The second warning
text: Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in!

name: An even deeper breath
text: The wolf took an even deeper breath. He huffed. He puffed.

name: Rattle and crack
text: The flower trembled. The walls rattled. And... down came the stick house!

name: Straight to Bruno
text: Pip and Poppy scrambled out the back and ran straight to Bruno's. Open up!

name: The strong door
text: Bruno opened the door. The pigs tumbled inside. Bruno shut it and slid the bolt.

name: I saved this
text: For a moment, nobody spoke. Then Poppy held up one slightly crumpled flower. I saved this.

name: The third house
text: The wolf arrived at the brick house. He looked at the walls. He looked at the roof.

name: Three more knocks
text: He knocked.

name: Let me come in
text: Little pigs, little pigs, let me come in!

name: Three voices together
text: All three pigs answered together. Not by the hairs on our chinny chin chins!

name: The third warning
text: Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in!

name: His biggest breath
text: He planted his feet. He filled his chest. He huffed. He puffed. And...

name: Nothing happened
text: Nothing happened.

name: Still a house
text: Inside, Pip opened one eye. Are we still a house? We're still a house, said Bruno.

name: Try again
text: The wolf tried again. His cheeks bulged. His ears quivered.

name: Out of puff
text: He blew until he had to sit down. One small leaf landed on his head. The house stood firm.

name: An idea
text: Then the wolf looked up. The chimney.

name: Footsteps overhead
text: Inside, the pigs heard footsteps on the roof. Pip pointed upward. Poppy looked toward the fireplace.

name: The washing tub
text: Bruno looked at the big tub of cold water beside his washing.

name: A plan together
text: The three pigs looked at one another. Then they got to work.

name: Into the fireplace
text: Together, they pushed the tub into the empty fireplace.

name: Into the chimney
text: Above them, the wolf squeezed into the chimney. Just a little farther, he muttered.

name: A slippery surprise
text: His feet slipped. His eyes widened. And down he came.

name: Only his ears
text: For one quiet moment, only his ears showed above the tub.

name: A very wet wolf
text: Then up popped a very wet wolf. Cold!

name: Dripping wet
text: He scrambled out, dripping from nose to tail.

name: Open the door
text: The pigs stood safely behind the kitchen table while Bruno pulled the cord that lifted the door latch.

name: No invitation needed
text: The door swung open. The wolf needed no invitation.

name: Away down the path
text: He dashed outside and disappeared down the woodland path. This time, the huffing and puffing came from running.

name: A new morning
text: The next morning, the three pigs got to work again. They built two more sturdy brick houses.

name: Everyone helps
text: Pip carried bricks. Poppy measured walls. Bruno showed them how to spread the mortar.

name: Flowers at every door
text: And when the houses were finished, Poppy decorated every doorway.

name: Supper together
text: That evening, the three pigs sat down together for supper.

name: One last knock
text: There was a knock.

name: Three spoons stop
text: Three spoons stopped halfway to three mouths. Bruno peeked through the window.

name: Only Rabbit
text: Then he smiled. It's only Rabbit.

name: A basket of buns
text: Rabbit held up a basket. I brought buns.

name: Room for one more
text: Pip opened the door. Poppy put out another plate. And Bruno made room at the table.

name: Warm and sturdy
text: Outside, the wind rustled the trees. Inside, the houses stayed sturdy, the buns stayed warm...

name: The end
text: And nobody had to run anywhere. The end.
